name: Step the replay one minute at a time with the scrubber's arrow keys
description: Validates the keyboard path through the timeline: the scrubber is a native slider named Replay time, and with it focused each arrow key moves the replay exactly one minute, the clock and the slider's spoken value agreeing.

planSteps.description: Navigate to /cases/eagle-s-2024?t=2024-12-25T12:00Z and wait up to 60 seconds for the 3D view (data-testid seabed-view) to reach data-state "ready"
Assert the slider labelled "Replay time" (data-testid replay-scrubber) has aria-valuetext "12:00 UTC" and the replay clock (data-testid replay-clock) reads "12:00 UTC"
Give the Replay time slider keyboard focus without clicking it (focus the element directly, since a click would move it), then press the ArrowRight key 3 times
Assert the replay clock reads "12:03 UTC" and the slider's aria-valuetext reads "12:03 UTC"
Assert the replay clock reads "12:02 UTC" and the slider's aria-valuetext reads "12:02 UTC"
